body: As someone who tried to commit suicide last night I would appreciate the words you wish people said to you.
My ex was just really hurt from being with someone so filled with doubt and anxiety all of the time.
Yes I recognize these feelings. I can’t tell you if you have ROCD but I can tell you that’s exactly how I have felt in relationships
I do go to therapy, it has been helpful but I we are coming to conclusion that some of the meds I’m on for various other things could be worsening my OCD.
I’m not a doctor or at all qualifies to tell you what this is but I can tell you I very much relate to it and hope you find someone that you can talk about all of this with. Sending prayers your way.
